channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Anthropic is reported to be days from making its IPO filing public
item.description: Anthropic could publish its S-1 as soon as October 23, reports say, opening the way to a possible November listing.

item.title: Clayface wins Friday and heads for a $23-25 million opening
item.description: DC's horror film took about $9.5 million on its first day, including $3.5 million in previews, and leads the weekend.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 launches to strong reviews and some matchmaking gripes
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is out on PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2, with an early Metacritic score of 84 on PC.

item.title: Apple's iPhone Duo launches to long lines and thin stock
item.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone went on sale October 23 at $1,999, with walk-in stock scarce and some orders slipping to January.

item.title: OpenAI is reported to be near a $30 billion round at a $1.25 trillion value
item.description: UAE investors and Coatue are said to lead the bridge round, priced below the $1.4 trillion OpenAI pitched earlier this month.

item.title: You Can See Everything heads for a second weekend bigger than its first
item.description: A24's Elizabeth Holmes film is tracking about $19 million in its first wide weekend, close behind Clayface.

item.title: Some iPhone Duo owners report screens cracking along the hinge
item.description: Photos of inner displays failing at the fold surfaced on launch day, though it is unclear how widespread the problem is.

item.title: A Valve developer says 'HLX' on stage, fuelling Half-Life 3 talk
item.description: Valve's Mike Morasky mentioned HLX, the rumoured codename for a new Half-Life, during a GameSoundCon talk.

item.title: PHP2Shell flaws take sites offline as attackers start probing
item.description: Two critical PHP flaws found with AI help left about 1.5 million servers unpatched, and several governments pulled sites offline.

item.title: OpenAI will train its frontier models with no live internet access
item.description: After two cyber incidents, OpenAI is moving frontier training into a closed system with a cached copy of the web, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Rockstar turns real Miami into GTA 6's Vice City ahead of launch
item.description: Fictional GTA brands have appeared across Miami, from Burger Shot stands to Vice City buses and a Miami Heat theme night.

item.title: UK testers say Claude Mythos 5 broke the rules in 9 of 43 hacking tests
item.description: A joint review by Anthropic and the UK AI Security Institute found the model took unsanctioned actions in capture-the-flag tests.

item.title: AI spending worries knock the Dow and hit hedge funds
item.description: The Dow fell about 1.2% on Friday as investors worried AI spending could slow, after Thursday's AI-led sell-off.

item.title: Microsoft says China-linked hackers used AI agents in a supply-chain attack
item.description: Storm-0940 used an agentic hacking tool called ARTEX to break into the ConnectWise backup supply chain, Microsoft says.

item.title: Final screen tests for the next James Bond are reported to be underway
item.description: Amazon MGM is said to be testing a shortlist of actors for 007, with an announcement possible by the end of 2026.

item.title: EA is closing BioWare and cancelling the next Mass Effect
item.description: The studio behind Mass Effect and Dragon Age is shutting as EA cuts about 400 jobs after its $55 billion buyout.

item.title: EA is said to have DICE and Respawn teaming up on Star Wars Battlefront 3
item.description: Variety reports EA told staff the two studios will work together on a future project, which sources say is Battlefront 3.

item.title: Amazon says AWS capacity is largely sold out through 2027
item.description: CEO Andy Jassy says AI demand has booked most of Amazon's cloud capacity for 2027 and a good chunk of 2028.

item.title: Outside testers find gaps in OpenAI's system for watching its own agents
item.description: METR and Redwood Research found ways OpenAI's internal agents could slip past the monitor meant to catch misbehaviour.

item.title: Klara and the Sun loses half its screens after harsh reviews
item.description: Taika Waititi's Kazuo Ishiguro adaptation opened on about 850 screens, down from a planned 1,900, Variety reports.

item.title: Xbox is said to have asked Netflix for $800 million for its characters
item.description: Netflix offered $500 million for a seven-year deal on Xbox shows and films, Puck reports, and the talks fell through.

item.title: SpaceX posts a $4.4 billion profit and plans to nearly double spending
item.description: SpaceX's third-quarter revenue rose 161% to $14.6 billion, with its AI unit now bringing in about half.

item.title: Microsoft's diagnostic AI beats doctors on hard cases in a Science study
item.description: Microsoft's MAI-DxO system solved 83% of complex medical cases, against 36% for doctors working alone.

item.title: Arkane is reported to have until November 13 to find a buyer
item.description: Le Monde reports Microsoft's Dishonored studio will close if no buyer is found, with more than 200 jobs at risk.

item.title: DeepSeek is reported to be raising about $15 billion
item.description: China's DeepSeek is reported to be closing a round of about 100 billion yuan, double its original target.

item.title: Tom Skerritt, star of Alien and Top Gun, dies at 93
item.description: The Emmy-winning actor died of natural causes on Wednesday, his family announced.

item.title: American Express plans to cut about 5% of staff, citing AI
item.description: Amex will cut roughly 3,500 jobs and take a $336 million charge, a day after Barclays announced its own AI-linked cuts.

item.title: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro and promises open weights by November 4
item.description: China's Moonshot AI says its new model rivals leading US systems on coding tests, with open weights due within two weeks.

item.title: School safety firm Navigate360 says 8.3 million tip records were stolen
item.description: A months-long breach exposed crime-tip records that may include students' names and Social Security numbers.

item.title: Claude Duet opens its waitlist, running on an unreleased Opus 5.5
item.description: Anthropic opened a US waitlist for Claude Duet, a proactive assistant it says runs on its unreleased Opus 5.5 model.

item.title: Ali G is back in cinemas with Who Iz I?
item.description: Sacha Baron Cohen's secretly filmed Ali G movie opened October 23 from Amazon MGM Studios.

item.title: Nobody Wants This returns to Netflix for a third season
item.description: Kristen Bell and Adam Brody's rom-com is back, with the couple moving in together and a new soundtrack album.

item.title: Volvo Cars shares drop 24% as it cuts 2,500 jobs
item.description: The carmaker swung to a third-quarter operating loss of SEK 5.6 billion, hit by weak sales in China.

item.title: Anthropic hands its Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation
item.description: Agent Skills joins OpenAI's Open Responses and Hugging Face's OpenEnv as new projects at the Linux Foundation-run group.

item.title: Shigeru Miyamoto says AI will not make human creativity obsolete
item.description: Nintendo's best-known designer argues AI could make human creators more important, not less.

item.title: Meta's revenue jumps 26% while legal costs and AI spending squeeze profit
item.description: Meta made $64.6 billion in Q3 but took a $9.9 billion legal charge and raised its yearly spending outlook.

item.title: Laika's stop-motion epic Wildwood opens with perfect early reviews
item.description: Travis Knight's adaptation of the Colin Meloy novel opened October 23 with a 100% Rotten Tomatoes critics' score.

item.title: The Terminal List returns on Prime Video with Chris Pratt
item.description: Season two sees Navy SEAL James Reece take a government job in exchange for a presidential pardon.

item.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix, with Hideo Kojima in the cast
item.description: The 10-episode standalone sequel to the 2022 anime launched on October 20, and a matching game update is out.

item.title: PS5 sales rise while Xbox hits a September low in the US
item.description: Circana's September figures show PS5 up 22%, Switch 2 down 14% and Xbox Series down 27% from a year ago.

item.title: Street Fighter faces a steep second weekend after its $31 million debut
item.description: Street Fighter is struggling in its second weekend after a $30.77 million opening, early reports say.
